description: The one Python the fleet runs (agent-fabric ADR-040, amended 2026-10-01): a relocatable python-build-standalone build, installed once per host under /usr/local/lib/agent-fabric/ by tools/fabric/python_pin.py and reached as /usr/local/bin/fabric-python. Each build is pinned by its sha256, computed from the downloaded archive and checked against upstream's SHA256SUMS when the pin was written; the installer refuses anything else. Moving the pin is a commit here, then `python_pin.py install` on each host.
